# 升级MCP服务器 [](https://cursor.com/en/install-mcp?name=upstash&config=eyJjb21tYW5kIjoibnB4IiwiYXJncyI6WyIteSIsIkB1cHN0YXNoL21jcC1zZXJ2ZXJAbGF0ZXN0IiwiLS1lbWFpbCIsIllPVVJfRU1BSUwiLCItLWFwaS1rZXkiLCJZT1VSX0FQSV9LRVkiXX0%3D) [](https://insiders.vscode.dev/redirect/mcp/install?name=upstash&inputs=%5B%7B%22id%22%3A%22email%22%2C%22type%22%3A%22promptString%22%2C%22description%22%3A%22Upstash%20email%22%7D%2C%7B%22id%22%3A%22apiKey%22%2C%22type%22%3A%22promptString%22%2C%22description%22%3A%22Upstash%20API%20key%22%2C%22password%22%3Atrue%7D%5D&config=%7B%22command%22%3A%22npx%22%2C%22args%22%3A%5B%22-y%22%2C%22%40upstash%2Fmcp-server%40latest%22%2C%22--email%22%2C%22%24%7Binput%3Aemail%7D%22%2C%22--api-key%22%2C%22%24%7Binput%3AapiKey%7D%22%5D%7D) Uptash MCP服务器允许您的代理直接管理和调试您的Uptash资源，跨 **瑞迪斯**, **QStash**, **工作流程**，以及 **[Uptash盒子](https://upstash.com/docs/box/overall/quickstart)**. > \[！提示\] > 对于大多数工作流，最好安装 [提升技能](https://upstash.com/docs/agent-resources/skills) 让你的经纪人开车 [`@upstash/cli`](https://upstash.com/docs/agent-resources/cli) 过度运行MCP服务器。 ## 快速入门 您需要您的Upstash帐户电子邮件和API密钥-在 [Uptash控制台→ 账户→ API密钥](https://console.upstash.com/account/api). Uptash MCP服务器可与任何兼容MCP的客户端配合使用。如果您的客户端未在下面列出，请查看其文档以了解如何添加stdio MCP服务器，然后将其指向基本命令： ```bash npx -y @upstash/mcp-server@latest --email YOUR_EMAIL --api-key YOUR_API_KEY ``` > \[！注意\] > 支持只读API密钥。当服务器启动时，它会自动禁用所有会修改状态的工具（创建数据库、删除备份、重试工作流等）。您的代理仍然可以读取和查询您的帐户，但无法进行更改。
Claude Code 在终端中运行此命令。请参阅 [克劳德代码MCP文档](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code/mcp) 了解更多信息。 ```sh claude mcp add --scope user upstash -- npx -y @upstash/mcp-server@latest --email YOUR_EMAIL --api-key YOUR_API_KEY ```
Cursor 首选 `Settings` → `Cursor Settings` → `MCP` → `Add new global MCP server`. 将以下配置粘贴到游标中 `~/.cursor/mcp.json` 文件是推荐的方法。您还可以通过创建以下内容在特定项目中安装 `.cursor/mcp.json` 在您的项目文件夹中。请参阅 [光标MCP文档](https://docs.cursor.com/context/model-context-protocol) 了解更多信息。 从Cursor 1.0开始，您可以单击下面的安装按钮进行即时一键安装。替换 `YOUR_EMAIL` 和 `YOUR_API_KEY` 在确认之前，先用你的真实价值观。 [](https://cursor.com/en/install-mcp?name=upstash&config=eyJjb21tYW5kIjoibnB4IiwiYXJncyI6WyIteSIsIkB1cHN0YXNoL21jcC1zZXJ2ZXJAbGF0ZXN0IiwiLS1lbWFpbCIsIllPVVJfRU1BSUwiLCItLWFwaS1rZXkiLCJZT1VSX0FQSV9LRVkiXX0%3D) ```json { "mcpServers": { "upstash": { "command": "npx", "args": [ "-y", "@upstash/mcp-server@latest", "--email", "YOUR_EMAIL", "--api-key", "YOUR_API_KEY" ] } } } ```
Windsurf 将此添加到您的Windsurf MCP配置文件中 `~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json`。请参阅 [Windsurf MCP文件](https://docs.windsurf.com/windsurf/cascade/mcp) 了解更多信息。 ```json { "mcpServers": { "upstash": { "command": "npx", "args": [ "-y", "@upstash/mcp-server@latest", "--email", "YOUR_EMAIL", "--api-key", "YOUR_API_KEY" ] } } } ```
OpenCode 将其添加到您的OpenCode配置文件中(`~/.config/opencode/opencode.json` 或项目级别 `opencode.json`).请参阅 [OpenCode MCP文档](https://opencode.ai/docs/mcp-servers) 了解更多信息。 ```json { "mcp": { "upstash": { "type": "local", "command": [ "npx", "-y", "@upstash/mcp-server@latest", "--email", "YOUR_EMAIL", "--api-key", "YOUR_API_KEY" ], "enabled": true } } } ```
OpenAI Codex 请参阅 [OpenAI Codex MCP文档](https://developers.openai.com/codex/mcp) 了解更多信息。 **使用CLI** ```sh codex mcp add upstash -- npx -y @upstash/mcp-server@latest --email YOUR_EMAIL --api-key YOUR_API_KEY ``` **手动配置** 将其添加到Codex配置文件中(`~/.codex/config.toml` 或 `.codex/config.toml`): ```toml [mcp_servers.upstash] command = "npx" args = ["-y", "@upstash/mcp-server@latest", "--email", "YOUR_EMAIL", "--api-key", "YOUR_API_KEY"] startup_timeout_sec = 20 ``` > \[！注意\] > 如果您看到启动超时错误，请增加 `startup_timeout_sec` 到 `40`.
VS Code 单击安装-VS代码将提示您输入电子邮件和API密钥（存储在其秘密存储中）： [](https://insiders.vscode.dev/redirect/mcp/install?name=upstash&inputs=%5B%7B%22id%22%3A%22email%22%2C%22type%22%3A%22promptString%22%2C%22description%22%3A%22Upstash%20email%22%7D%2C%7B%22id%22%3A%22apiKey%22%2C%22type%22%3A%22promptString%22%2C%22description%22%3A%22Upstash%20API%20key%22%2C%22password%22%3Atrue%7D%5D&config=%7B%22command%22%3A%22npx%22%2C%22args%22%3A%5B%22-y%22%2C%22%40upstash%2Fmcp-server%40latest%22%2C%22--email%22%2C%22%24%7Binput%3Aemail%7D%22%2C%22--api-key%22%2C%22%24%7Binput%3AapiKey%7D%22%5D%7D) [](https://insiders.vscode.dev/redirect/mcp/install?name=upstash&inputs=%5B%7B%22id%22%3A%22email%22%2C%22type%22%3A%22promptString%22%2C%22description%22%3A%22Upstash%20email%22%7D%2C%7B%22id%22%3A%22apiKey%22%2C%22type%22%3A%22promptString%22%2C%22description%22%3A%22Upstash%20API%20key%22%2C%22password%22%3Atrue%7D%5D&config=%7B%22command%22%3A%22npx%22%2C%22args%22%3A%5B%22-y%22%2C%22%40upstash%2Fmcp-server%40latest%22%2C%22--email%22%2C%22%24%7Binput%3Aemail%7D%22%2C%22--api-key%22%2C%22%24%7Binput%3AapiKey%7D%22%5D%7D&quality=insiders) 或将此添加到 `.vscode/mcp.json` （或您的用户 `mcp.servers` 设置）。使用 `inputs` 随着 `promptString` 意味着您的API密钥只提示一次，并保存在VS Code的秘密存储中，而不是保存在配置文件中。请参阅 [VS代码MCP文档](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/chat/mcp-servers) 了解更多信息。 ```json { "inputs": [ { "type": "promptString", "id": "email", "description": "Upstash email" }, { "type": "promptString", "id": "apiKey", "description": "Upstash API key", "password": true } ], "servers": { "upstash": { "type": "stdio", "command": "npx", "args": [ "-y", "@upstash/mcp-server@latest", "--email", "${input:email}", "--api-key", "${input:apiKey}" ] } } } ```
Google Antigravity 将此添加到您的反重力MCP配置中。请参阅 [反重力MCP文档](https://antigravity.google/docs/mcp) 了解更多信息。 ```json { "mcpServers": { "upstash": { "command": "npx", "args": [ "-y", "@upstash/mcp-server@latest", "--email", "YOUR_EMAIL", "--api-key", "YOUR_API_KEY" ] } } } ```
Claude Desktop 打开Claude Desktop的开发人员设置并编辑 `claude_desktop_config.json`。请参阅 [克劳德桌面MCP文档](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/quickstart/user) 了解更多信息。 ```json { "mcpServers": { "upstash": { "command": "npx", "args": [ "-y", "@upstash/mcp-server@latest", "--email", "YOUR_EMAIL", "--api-key", "YOUR_API_KEY" ] } } } ```
Gemini CLI 在以下位置打开Gemini CLI设置文件 `~/.gemini/settings.json` 并将Uptash添加到 `mcpServers`。参见 [Gemini CLI配置](https://google-gemini.github.io/gemini-cli/docs/tools/mcp-server.html) 了解详情。 ```json { "mcpServers": { "upstash": { "command": "npx", "args": [ "-y", "@upstash/mcp-server@latest", "--email", "YOUR_EMAIL", "--api-key", "YOUR_API_KEY" ] } } } ```
## 示例提示 ### 瑞迪斯 - _“在us-east-1中创建一个新的Redis数据库”_ - _“按内存使用情况列出我的数据库”_ - _“通过从Redis拉取来更新用户架构”_ - _创建此数据库的备份，然后清除它_ - _“显示过去7天的吞吐量峰值”_ ### QStash和工作流程 - _“检查QStash日志，找出我的webhook一直失败的原因”_ - _“查找用户失败的工作流运行 `@admin` 今天”_ - _“重试2小时前启动的失败的工作流运行”_ - _“按错误类型分组，总结DLQ中当前的内容”_ - _“暂停抛出错误的计划”_ ### Uptash盒子 - _启动一个Box，克隆此仓库，并运行测试_ - _“快照此框并从中创建5个副本，为每个副本分配一个GitHub问题”_ - _“My Box一直无法启动，请检查日志并告诉我出了什么问题”_ ## Upstash Box API键（可选） MCP与 [Uptash盒子](https://upstash.com/docs/box/overall/quickstart)，代理需要您的Box API密钥。默认情况下，您必须将其粘贴到聊天中（或将其保存在 `.env`)每次代理运行Box工具时。为了避免这种情况，您可以将密钥连接到MCP设置本身，以便服务器在启动时自动拾取它。 你可以通过两种方式传递它。 **命令行标志** ```json { "mcpServers": { "upstash": { "command": "npx", "args": [ "-y", "@upstash/mcp-server@latest", "--email", "YOUR_EMAIL", "--api-key", "YOUR_API_KEY", "--box-api-key", "YOUR_BOX_API_KEY" ] } } } ``` **环境变量** ```json { "mcpServers": { "upstash": { "command": "npx", "args": [ "-y", "@upstash/mcp-server@latest", "--email", "YOUR_EMAIL", "--api-key", "YOUR_API_KEY" ], "env": { "UPSTASH_BOX_API_KEY": "YOUR_BOX_API_KEY" } } } } ``` ## 调试 如果服务器行为异常或工具一直出现故障，请使用启用详细日志记录 `--debug` 标志： ```json { "mcpServers": { "upstash": { "command": "npx", "args": [ "-y", "@upstash/mcp-server@latest", "--email", "YOUR_EMAIL", "--api-key", "YOUR_API_KEY", "--debug" ] } } } ``` 然后将每个内部事件写入 **标准错误**，您的MCP客户端会在其自己的日志查看器中显示这些日志。在报告问题时分享相关片段 [GitHub](https://github.com/upstash/mcp/issues). ## 遥测 服务器在每次请求时向Upstash发送匿名诊断信息：MCP服务器SDK版本、运行时版本（Node、Bun等）和基本平台信息（操作系统和架构）。 **不收集帐户数据、工具参数或结果。** 要选择退出，请添加 `--disable-telemetry` 到args。 ## 发展 克隆项目并运行： ```bash bun i bun run watch ``` 这会不断构建项目并观察变化。 为了测试，创建一个 `.env` 项目根目录中的文件： ```bash UPSTASH_EMAIL= UPSTASH_API_KEY= # Optional, for Box tools: UPSTASH_BOX_API_KEY= ``` 要将本地MCP服务器安装到Claude Code中，请执行以下操作： ```bash claude mcp add --transport stdio upstash -- bun --watch dist/index.js --debug ``` 要实时跟踪MCP服务器的日志： ```bash bun run logs ```
